Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 8658- 1978 




Indian Standard 

PURCHASER'S DATA SHEET FOR 
VIBRATING SCREENS 



Reaffirmed 2006 ) 



1. Scope — Covers the technical data to be supplied by a purchaser while placing an enquiry or 
order to a supplier for the purchase of a vibrating screen. 

2* Purchaser's Data Sheet 



PURCHASER'S DATA SHEET FOR VIBRATING SCREENS 



Input Material 



1) Material to be screened 

2) Function of screening: 

a) Scalping 

b) Dewatering 

c) Sizing 

d) Screening 

e) Rinsing or washing 

3) Characteristics of screen feed ( tick right ): 

a) Very dry 

b) Damp but clean 

c) Granular 

d) Clayey (state percentage of clay 
also ) 

e) Damp or sticky 

f) Very wet 

g) Flaky 

h) Washed 

j) Fluffy 

k) Fibrous 

4) Sieve analysis of feed: 

Sieve Designation 



m) Abrasive 

n) Hygroscopic 

p) Corrosive 

q) Explosive 

r) Dusty 

s) Degradable 

t) Hot (state temperature also). 



u) Angle of repose, 
v) Any other 



Percent Mass Between Sieves 



Note — If exact analysis is not available then 5 kg of the representative sample may be sent for the 
determination of the size analysis. 

5) Size of largest piece in screen feed... mm 

6) Bulk mass of material t/m 3 

7) Moisture content of feed: 

a) Normal percent 

b) Maximum percent 

8) Size distribution of the product desired: 

Product No. Size Range Percent of Feed 

1 Between microns and microns 

2 Between : microns and microns 

3 Between microns and microns 

9) Feed rate in tonnes per hour ( solids ): 

a) Normal 

b) Maximum 

10) Feed rate: 

a) Continuous 

b) Intermittent 

( Continued )

percent

General Data 

19) Screen drive: 

a) Whether by belt

a) Right hand

a) Suspended

c) Length m 

Note — A pencil sketch showing headroom, floor space and desired space for screen in relation to crushers, 
elevators, bins and line shaft may be submitted. 

24) The desired and permissible shape of openings in wire screen cloth or punched plate ( Mark 
with D and P respectively): 

a) Square 

b) Rectangular , 

c) Long slot 

d) Circular 

e) Any other

a) Steel 

b) Brass 

c) Phosphor bronze 

d) Stainless steel 

e) Any other 

Remarks 

26) Any special requirements 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The information given by a purchaser according to this data sheet will enable a manufacturer 
or a supplier'tcvassess the exact requirements of the purchaser and to recommend to him the most 
suitable type -of equipment.
